quote: Template Filling synthesizes in-class texts by filling in the blanks.
Potential Text Mining gathers raw texts with beneficial components to synthesize in-class texts for the target minority class.
Template Filling prompts an LLM to fill in the blanks in T, which produces a grafted text that generally falls in the target class c.
outputs: Generated texts for minority classes by filling templates.
synthetic in-class (grafted) texts generated for minority classes
Synthetic texts for minority classes (e.g., 'Surprised', 'Optimism', 'Religion', 'Politics', 'Mechanical Engineering')

quote: We use the F1 score as the metric for evaluation.
